app.title: AI BEAVER {version} – AI Hardware Checker
args.batch: image models: how many images at once (default 1)
args.context: context length in tokens, e.g. 8192 or 16k (default 8k)
args.description: Will this language model run on your computer, and how fast?
args.explain: show the explanation: what uses memory and what you can do
args.fake_hw: hardware profile from a JSON file instead of a scan (testing)
args.model: Hugging Face link, hf.co/<repo>:QUANT, a path to a .gguf file, or ollama:NAME
args.quant: quantization, e.g. Q4_K_M (default: from the link or Q4_K_M)
args.ram: your own RAM size in GB instead of the detected one
args.resolution: image models: resolution, e.g. 1024 or 1024x768 (default: native for the family)
args.scan: list models installed on this computer (known app folders or the given FOLDER)
args.update_catalog: download a newer model list for suggestions (from the project repository)
args.vram: your own VRAM in GB instead of the detected cards; several cards comma-separated, e.g. 24,24
catalog.bad: The downloaded model list is damaged – keeping the current one.
catalog.current: Your model list is up to date ({count} models, as of {date}).
catalog.failed: Couldn't download the model list. Check your internet connection.
catalog.updated: Model list updated: {count} models, as of {date}.
cli.ask_model_hint: Paste a Hugging Face model link, hf.co/<repo>:Q4_K_M or a path to a .gguf file.
cli.hint_explain: Why? Add --explain to see the explanation and suggestions.
cli.legend: = VRAM {vram}  - RAM {ram}  # weights {weights}  + chat memory {kv}  : overhead {overhead}

cli.loading_remote: Fetching the model description from Hugging Face…

cli.scan_hint: Check a model: python main.py "PATH" (or ollama:NAME)
cli.scan_known: Looking for models where Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face, llama.cpp and GPT4All keep them…
cli.scan_none: No models found. If you keep them elsewhere, give the folder: --scan FOLDER
cli.scan_partial: Unfinished downloads take up {size}. No program will use these incomplete files – they can be deleted.
cli.unknown_quant: The model has no {quant} quantization. Available: {available}
detection.missing: Couldn't read the graphics card memory or RAM. Fill in the missing values manually: --vram GB and/or --ram GB.
detection.unsupported: Hardware detection doesn't work on this system yet ({platform}). Enter it manually: --ram GB and --vram GB.
detection.unsupported_gui: Hardware detection doesn't work on this system yet ({platform}). Enter RAM and VRAM manually.
expl.act.combo: only quantization {quant}, context {ctx} and KV cache q8_0 together fit {where},
expl.act.cpu_only: without a graphics card the processor runs every model – a smaller model or a lower quantization will answer faster,
expl.act.decoder_cpu: running the audio decoder on the CPU frees {size} on the card – the model then fits {where}, and decoding is only slightly slower,
expl.act.img_batch: one image at a time fits {where},
expl.act.img_nothing: even smaller images won't be enough – you need a smaller model (e.g. SD 1.5 instead of SDXL) or more RAM.
expl.act.kv: KV cache in q8_0 (a runtime option) fits {where},
expl.act.moe_offload: in LM Studio turn on "Force Model Expert Weights onto CPU", in llama.cpp use --cpu-moe or --n-cpu-moe – the experts stay in RAM and the rest of the model on the card, which usually speeds up answers noticeably,
expl.act.nothing: even quantization {quant} with context {ctx} doesn't fit on the card – you need a smaller model,
expl.act.nothing_cpu: even quantization {quant} with context {ctx} doesn't fit in RAM – you need a smaller model,
expl.act.nothing_red: even quantization {quant} with context {ctx} doesn't fit in the computer's memory – you need a smaller model or more RAM,
expl.act.title: What you can do:
expl.img.decode_tiled: {size} decoding the image in tiles (VAE {vae} + compute {comp}),
expl.img.encode_cpu: the CPU encodes the prompt (text encoders {enc} in RAM),
expl.img.title: The most memory is needed for {stage}: {peak}.
expl.need.decoder_cpu: {size} audio decoder ({decoder}, on the CPU – in RAM),
expl.need.embd_ram: The vocabulary table ({size}) stays in RAM, not on the card – that is how llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio work.
expl.need.kv_swa: {size} chat memory (context {ctx}; most layers keep only the latest tokens),
expl.need.title: The model needs {total}:
expl.pc.all_in_ram: the whole model ({size}) goes to RAM,
expl.pc.fits: everything fits on the card with {margin} to spare.
expl.pc.img_fits: the heaviest stage fits on the card with {margin} to spare.
expl.pc.img_slow_cpu: the CPU ({cpu}) renders the image – usually minutes instead of seconds per image.
expl.pc.img_stream: the main part will be streamed from RAM while drawing – every step takes longer.
expl.pc.ram_busy: other programs use {used} of RAM right now – close some of them before running the model.
expl.pc.short: {short} missing: the model doesn't fit even in the card and RAM together ({capacity}).
expl.pc.slow: the processor {cpu} and RAM{ram} are several times slower than the card, so answers will be slow.
expl.pc.slow_cpu: the processor {cpu} with RAM{ram} does the work – it runs, but several times slower than on a card.
expl.pc.slow_little: the processor handles only a small part of the model, so the slowdown will be moderate.
expl.pc.slow_moe: this is an MoE model: each word uses only {active} of {total} parameters, so it should stay usable despite the part in RAM.
expl.pc.title: Your computer:
expl.spare.context: you can raise the context to {ctx},
expl.spare.img_res: you can render bigger images – up to {res} entirely on the card,
expl.spare.none: the model uses almost the whole card – nothing bigger fits.
expl.spare.quant: {quant} ({size}) fits on the card too – better quality.
expl.spare.title: You still have room:
expl.where.ram: on the card and in RAM (slower)

gui.scan_consent: AI BEAVER will look in the folders where apps keep models (Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face, llama.cpp, GPT4All). It reads only file names, sizes and headers. Nothing is sent to the internet.
gui.scan_found: Found {count} models, {size} in total. Double-click a model to check it.
gui.scan_none: No models found in the usual places. Keep them elsewhere? Use “Search a folder…”.
gui.scan_none_folder: No models found in this folder.
gui.scan_not_checkable: AI BEAVER won't rate this file: it's an add-on (LoRA, VAE, projector) or a format we don't open for safety (.ckpt).
gui.token_prompt:
Hugging Face token (for models that require accepting a license).
It is stored only on this computer. An empty field removes the token.
gui.unavailable: Can't open a window (no tkinter or no display) – starting text mode.
manual.active_params_range: Active parameters can't exceed total parameters.
manual.incomplete_architecture: Enter all three values: layers, KV heads and head size – or none of them.
manual.not_positive: Values must be greater than zero.
manual.params_required: Enter the number of model parameters (in billions).
note.audio_by_name: Recognised from the file name – probably a {kind}.
note.audio_decoder_estimate: The audio decoder memory ({size}) is an estimate – not measured yet.
note.audio_decoder_unknown: This is a {kind}, but its audio decoder is unknown – it may need extra memory that isn't counted here.
note.context_exceeds: Context {ctx} is longer than the model supports ({max}).
note.estimate: Estimated result – the model data is incomplete.
note.img_assumed: The text encoders and VAE aren't in this file – we assumed the usual ones for {family} ({size}).
note.img_encoders_cpu: The text encoder ({size}) doesn't fit on the card – the CPU will encode the prompt, a few seconds longer.
note.img_estimate: Compute memory for image models is an estimate for now – waiting for measurements.
note.img_low_margin: Small margin – a higher resolution, more images at once or other programs may exceed the memory.
note.img_tiled: At this resolution the image will be decoded in tiles (tiled VAE) – ComfyUI and Forge do this on their own.
note.img_unknown: We didn't recognise this image model's family – the estimate is cautious.
note.low_margin: Small margin – a longer context or other programs may exceed the memory.
ollama.no_metadata: Ollama didn't provide this model's data.
ollama.not_found: Ollama has no such model. List: ollama list.
ollama.not_running: Ollama isn't responding. Start it (ollama serve or the system service) and try again.
scan.note.copy: the same model is also elsewhere
source.access_denied: No access to the model. The repository may be private – set a Hugging Face token in the settings.
source.audio_model: This looks like an audio or music model in a format AI BEAVER can't read yet – support is planned.
source.bad_file: The model file is damaged or incomplete.
source.empty_input: Pick a model: a link, hf.co/<repo>:QUANT or a .gguf file.
source.gated: This model requires accepting its license on Hugging Face. Accept it on the model page and set an HF token in the settings, or enter the data manually.
source.gguf_version: Unsupported GGUF file version (very old or big-endian).
source.http_error: Hugging Face returned an unexpected response. Try again in a moment.
source.image_addon: This is an add-on for an image model (LoRA or a VAE alone), not a whole model – pick the model file (checkpoint).
source.image_model: This looks like an image or video generation model. AI BEAVER checks language models for now – images are planned.
source.is_directory: That's a folder, not a model file. Pick a .gguf file.
source.network: Can't reach Hugging Face. Check your internet connection or pick a .gguf file from disk.
source.no_model_files: This repository has no model files (no GGUF or config.json).
source.not_found: Model not found. Check the link or the repository name.
source.not_gguf: This is not a GGUF file.
source.range_unsupported: The server doesn't allow fetching just the file header.
source.split_incomplete: Part of the split model file is missing.
source.text_safetensors: This is a single weights file of a language model – pick the folder with config.json or a .gguf file.
source.unknown_quant: The model has no such quantization.
source.unrecognized_input: I don't recognize this. Paste a Hugging Face link, hf.co/<repo>:Q4_K_M or a path to a .gguf file.
source.unsupported_site: Ollama, LM Studio and Jan pages don't expose model data. Use a Hugging Face link (e.g. hf.co/<repo>:Q4_K_M) or a .gguf file.
verdict.green: It will run on your computer – entirely on the graphics card.
verdict.image_cpu: Without a graphics card the CPU renders the image – very slowly.
verdict.image_green_all: It will run on your computer – all parts fit on the graphics card at once.
verdict.image_green_stages: It will run on your computer – on the card in stages: parts are swapped, the image itself renders at full speed.
verdict.image_yellow: It will run, but slower – the main part doesn't fit on the card and will be streamed from RAM.
verdict.yellow: It will run slowly – {pct}% of the model fits on the card, the rest goes to RAM.
verdict.yellow_cpu: It will run slowly – no graphics card, the processor does the work.
verdict.yellow_moe: Slower than on the card alone, but usable – MoE model, {pct}% on the card.
verdict.yellow_mostly: It will run, but a bit slower – {pct}% of the model fits on the card, the processor handles the rest.
warn.amd_runtime: AMD cards: support depends on the runtime (ROCm only for some cards, the rest via Vulkan). Check the Ollama or LM Studio docs.
warn.intel_runtime: Intel cards: support depends on the runtime (usually via Vulkan). Check the Ollama or LM Studio docs.
warn.mixed_gpu_vendors: Cards from different vendors don't work together in one runtime – only the group with more VRAM counts.
warn.nvidia_driver_old: NVIDIA driver too old for Ollama – update it (550+, 570+ for older cards).
warn.nvidia_legacy: Older NVIDIA card (Maxwell, Pascal, Volta): works only with CUDA 12 builds or via Vulkan; future versions may drop it.
warn.nvidia_unsupported: This NVIDIA card is too old for CUDA in Ollama and llama.cpp – it may only work via Vulkan.
